'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Chris Gogolen DS Kessel Run''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel Run (V) (Virtual Block 8)|Kessel Run (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
